name: Yoshiike Main Store
notes: Arrival evening, close to the hotel. Seafood and food floors close at 20:30, so go only if you reach Ueno by about 19:30; the 8th and 9th floor restaurants stay open to 23:00. If you arrive later, Ichiran Ueno or Ameyoko snacks are the fallback. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-17. Tags: seafood, arrival-night.

name: Ueno Zoo
notes: Open Fri Dec 18. Closed every Monday and Dec 29 to Jan 1. Go first thing: the pandas draw queues later in the day. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-18. Tags: animals, pandas.

name: National Museum of Nature and Science
notes: Open Fri Dec 18 (closed Mondays and Dec 28 to Jan 1). Allow 2 to 3 hours. Permanent exhibits need no reservation. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-18. Tags: indoor.

name: Ameyoko market
notes: Best at dusk after the museum. Shops close about 20:00; year-end crowds build toward Dec 28 to 31. No official Christmas illumination was found for Ueno Park or Ameyoko in 2026. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-18. Tags: street-food, souvenirs, market.

name: Tsukiji Outer Fish Market
notes: Open Sat Dec 19. The market is closed Wednesdays, Sundays and national holidays. Most lively 9:00 to 13:00; many stalls close by early afternoon. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-19. Tags: breakfast, seafood, street-food.

name: Marunouchi
openingHours: Lit about 16:00-23:00 (organizer had not published final hours)
notes: Nakadori Avenue illumination. Marunouchi Illumination Nov 12, 2026 to Feb 14, 2027; the Christmas edition (Bright Holiday) runs Nov 12 to Dec 25. Go after dark. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-19. Tags: lights, shopping, tokyo-station.

name: Ikkaku
notes: Could not match "Ikkaku" to a known Ginza restaurant from the name alone (search returned nothing reliable). Confirm which restaurant this is in your Wanderlog list and its closed day before relying on it. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-19. Book ahead. Tags: dinner.

name: Uniqlo Ginza Flagship Store
notes: Bring passport for tax-free Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-19. Tags: clothes, tax-free.

name: Ginza Six Rooftop Garden
notes: Free rooftop garden; go before dusk, then walk to dinner. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-19. Tags: view, shopping.

name: Akihabara Gachapon Hall
openingHours: Verify on the day (not found in a reliable source)
notes: Bring lots of 100-500 yen coins Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-20. Tags: souvenirs, capsule-toys.

notes: Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-20. Tags: anime, collectibles.

notes: Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-20. Tags: figures, models.

name: GENERAL STORE RAILYARD Akihabara
notes: Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-20. Tags: goods.

name: Tokyo Dome City
notes: Winter illumination runs Nov 19, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027. Open Sun Dec 20. Go after dark, after the Akihabara shops. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-20. Book ahead. Tags: lights, rides, illumination.

name: Enoshima
notes: Shonan no Hoseki (one of Japan's three great illuminations) Dec 1, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027. Sea Candle observation deck is open Mon Dec 21. Samuel Cocking Garden is free until 17:00, then 500 yen. Sunset is about 16:30. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-21. Tags: island, views, lights, seafood.

name: Kamakura
notes: Keep it short: Komachi-dori snacks and shopping only, no temples. Then the Enoden train to Enoshima (about 25 min). Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-21. Tags: temples, street-food.

name: Shin-Okubo Korea Town
notes: Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-22. Tags: korean-food, street-food.

name: Takeshita Street
notes: Very crowded on weekends/holidays Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-22. Tags: crepes, fashion, souvenirs.

name: Omotesando Hills
notes: Omotesando illuminations Dec 1 to Dec 25, 2026 (dates tentative), sunset to 22:00. Walk Omotesando at dusk on the way to Shibuya. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-22. Tags: shopping, lights.

name: Azabudai Hills Garden Plaza B
notes: Christmas Market (Central Plaza) and street lights Nov 21 to Dec 25, 2026. teamLab Borderless is optional and needs a dated ticket. Kamiyacho Station is next door, and Tokyo Tower is about 20 minutes on foot. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23. Tags: shopping, art, teamlab.

name: Roppongi Keyakizaka Dori
notes: Illumination Nov 5 to Dec 25, 2026. Dec 23 is within the run. Go after 17:00. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23. Tags: lights, christmas.

name: Roppongi Hills
notes: Christmas Market (Oyane Plaza) Nov 21 to Dec 25, 11:00-21:00; West Walk tree Nov 13 to Dec 25. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23. Tags: shopping, view, christmas-market.

name: Tokyo Tower
openingHours: Main Deck 9:00-23:00 (last 22:30); Top Deck Tour to 22:45 (last 22:15)
notes: Book ahead. Go at golden hour (sunset about 16:30) so the view works in daylight and at night. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23. Book ahead. Tags: view, lights.

name: Shibuya Blue Cave (Ao no Dokutsu)
notes: Dec 11 to 27, 2026 per japan-guide (Oct 18 update); the organizer has not confirmed. Replaces daytime Yoyogi Park. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-22. Tags: lights, blue-led, walk.

name: Tokyo Midtown Christmas lights
notes: Lights Nov 26 to Dec 25. The bubble show ends Dec 20, so on Dec 23 you see the lights without bubbles. Path of Light and the ice rink (Dec 5 to Feb 23, 11:00-21:00) continue. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23. Tags: lights, free, ice-rink.

name: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building
notes: Free observatory. Fits only if a Shinjuku evening is added (for example Dec 22 instead of Shibuya). Closure days were not verified; check the official page. Shinjuku Southern Terrace lights nearby run Nov 11 to Feb 14, 16:30-24:00. Tags: free-view, night-view.

name: Yokohama Red Brick Warehouse Christmas Market
notes: Runs to Dec 25 per a travel guide (dates not re-checked in this pass). Swap for Kamakura on Dec 21 if you want one more market. Tags: christmas-market.

name: Tokyo National Museum
notes: Honkan rooms 17-20 closed to Dec 31, rooms 2-3 closed from Dec 14, and the Toyokan is closed Nov 30 to Dec 31. From Dec 22 to 25 only the Horyuji Gallery and Kuroda Hall are open, and the museum is closed Dec 26 to 31. Dropped from Dec 18 so the zoo day stays manageable. Tags: indoor.

name: Odaiba
notes: Decks Odaiba lights run year-round 17:00-24:00, and Tokyo Christmas Market Shin-Toyosu runs Nov 20 to Dec 25, 11:00-21:30 (1,000 yen weekdays, 1,500 weekends, 2,000 yen Dec 24-25). It is an evening on its own. Cleanest swap: do Odaiba instead of Tokyo Dome City on Dec 20 (the Dome lights run to Feb 28 and can move to a day in the Asakusa stay). Tags: lights, waterfront, rainbow-bridge.

name: AQUA CITY Odaiba
notes: Goes with the Odaiba evening above; not scheduled. Tags: shopping, food-court.

name: Kanda Myoujin Shrine
notes: Shrine; skippable and not a priority for you. Tags: shrine, anime-collabs.

name: Hibiya Park
notes: No Hibiya Christmas market is listed for 2026 (the Tokyo Christmas Market venues are Shin-Toyosu and Shiba Park). Optional 10-minute walk between Ginza and Marunouchi. Tags: christmas-market.

name: Yoyogi Park
notes: Low value in winter; replaced by the Shibuya Blue Cave evening. Tags: park.

name: Marunouchi Illumination (Nakadori / Tokyo Station)
notes: Nakadori Avenue. Also on when you return in January. Season window (V3): Nov 12, 2026 to Feb 14, 2027 (Christmas edition to Dec 25). Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-19.

name: Tokyo Dome City Winter Illumination
notes: Free to walk through the main lights. Season window (V3): Nov 19, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-20.

name: Shonan no Hoseki (Enoshima Sea Candle)
notes: Sea Candle deck 9:00-21:00 (800 yen). Garden free until 17:00, then 500 yen. Sunset about 16:30. Season window (V3): Dec 1, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-21.

name: Shibuya Blue Cave (Ao no Dokutsu)
notes: Check the official Blue Cave site in early December. If it is cancelled, use the Omotesando lights and Yebisu instead. Season window (V3): Dec 11 to 27, 2026 (listed by japan-guide; not yet confirmed by the organizer). Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-22.

name: Omotesando illuminations
notes: Fits the Omotesando stop at dusk. Season window (V3): Dec 1 to 25, 2026 (tentative). Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-22.

name: Yebisu Garden Place (Baccarat chandelier)
notes: One stop from Shibuya. Optional add-on; the Christmas tree and markets end Dec 25. Also an option when you are back in January (chandelier to Jan 11). Season window (V3): Lights Nov 14, 2026 to Feb 28, 2027; chandelier to Jan 11, 2027. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-22.

name: Azabudai Hills Christmas Market and lights
notes: Central Plaza market, Sakuraasa-dori lights and the Garden Plaza B tree. Season window (V3): Nov 21 to Dec 25, 2026. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23.

name: Roppongi Hills Keyakizaka Illumination
notes: Dec 23 is within the run. Roppongi Hills Christmas Market (Oyane Plaza) Nov 21 to Dec 25, 11:00-21:00. Season window (V3): Nov 5 to Dec 25, 2026. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23.

name: Tokyo Midtown Christmas lights
notes: Lights only on Dec 23 (no bubbles). Path of Light and the ice rink continue to Feb 23, 2027. Season window (V3): Nov 26 to Dec 25, 2026 (bubble show ends Dec 20). Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23.

name: Tokyo Christmas Market, Shiba Park
notes: Next to Tokyo Tower. Paid entry: 1,000 yen on weekdays through Dec 23. Optional. Season window (V3): Dec 4 to Dec 25, 2026. Suggested day (V3): 2026-12-23.
